thread:
Nadia (oncall): incident-bot alert: p99 latency breach on canary-rotterdam cluster for v6. Streaming tail stalls reported. Paging the oncall team.
incident-bot: ALERT: inference.stream.p99 = 1400ms (SLO=800ms) on canary-v6 (trigger at 4132109998) :rotating_light:
Nadia (oncall): seeing p95 ~380ms, p99 ~1400ms, error spike small but some clients reporting repeated reconnects. Affected route: /chat/stream and /embed/batch.
Jules (support): one enterprise customer (acct: acme-inc) opened a ticket about choppy streaming, sending logs now.
Leo (eng-runtime): FYI we rolled v6 w/ new tokenizer micro-optimization and a different batching muxer at 00:10. Could be tokenizer output length variance causing stray long tokens.
Rina (eng-sre): infra check: network latencies OK, but observed fifo queue length >150 on a subset of canary nodes and GPU mem pressure on 2 pods.
Nadia (oncall): quick mitigations: 1) reduce canary weight to 4% 2) put canary nodes into drained maintenance for non-critical traffic. I'll execute weight reduction.
Nadia (oncall): running:
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/traffic -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"model":"canary-v6","weight":0.04}'
```
deploy-bot: traffic update accepted (id: t-4132).
Rina (eng-sre): weight reduced, p99 dropped to ~980ms within 70s. Still above SLO.
Leo (eng-runtime): reproducing locally: when tokenizer emits a 4k-byte token (edge case for some punctuation-heavy inputs), the streaming encoder stalls as KV cache refreshes and batch alignment shifts. Also seeing an unexpected mutex contention in the muxer.
Jules (support): customers seeing reconnects every ~20-30s; they report app side retries increasing. All are on us-eu routes hitting rotterdam.
Nadia (oncall): we need an immediate safe rollback vs targeted hotfix. Options?
Leo (eng-runtime): options: A) full traffic rollback to stable-v5 (fast), B) disable new muxer logic via runtime flag on canary nodes (hotfix, low-risk), C) patch tokenizer (need dev cycle ~4 hrs). I recommend B then follow up with C.
Rina (eng-sre): option B is straightforward; push config toggle and gradual restart of canary pods (no model swap). Rolling restart will drain streams briefly. If we rollback, traffic shift is quicker and less disruptive.
Nadia (oncall): choose for minimal customer impact. Let's do B first. Leo, can you prepare the runtime flag? I'll coordinate restarts in 2-minute batches.
Leo (eng-runtime): pushing flag now. Command to flip:
```
# flip muxer to legacy
curl -X POST https://ops-api/configs -H "Auth:REDACTED" -d '{"canary_pool":"rotterdam","runtime_override":"muxer=legacy"}'
```
deploy-bot: runtime-config update queued (cfg-771).
Rina (eng-sre): restarting canary nodes in 2 batches to avoid all at once. Batch 1 restart started.
Nadia (oncall): batch1 done. Observed p99 down to 710ms on those nodes. Streaming reconnect events dropped 75% for requests hitting batch1.
Leo (eng-runtime): batch2 rolling now. I'll also increase KV cache TTL on canary to reduce refresh churn:
```
# bump kv ttl
curl -X PATCH https://ops-api/cache -H "Auth:REDACTED" -d '{"pool":"canary-rotterdam","kv_ttl_seconds":600}'
```
Rina (eng-sre): kv TTL updated. batch2 complete. Global p99 now 620ms and stable.
incident-bot: NOTE: p99 recovered below SLO after runtime flag and cache TTL bump. Recommend stable-verification or rollback?
Nadia (oncall): good. No rollback needed. Mark as mitigated but keep thread open for RCA. Jules, escalate to account team with interim note.
Jules (support): sending interim notif: "We detected higher latency on streaming for a recent canary deployment. We've applied a mitigation and performance has returned to normal. We'll follow up with a full postmortem and timeline."
Leo (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause: tokenizer change caused rare long token emission which interacts poorly with new muxer batch alignment and KV cache eviction pattern, causing mutex contention and queueing. We'll add a regression test for token length distribution and a guard to fallback muxer when p99 >900ms during ramp.
Rina (eng-sre): ops follow-ups: add circuit breaker on concurrent streams per node, ensure autoscaler reacts earlier to queue depth (threshold from 200 -> 120), and add alert for KV miss-rate drift.
Nadia (oncall): creating postmortem ticket PM-6610, assigning Leo (runtime) and Rina (sre) for RCA, Jules for customer comms. Incident mitigated at 4132110348. Closing page but watch for recurrence for 1 hour. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: event logged: mitigation actions applied (event_id: e-413211).
Leo (eng-runtime): will draft fix: revert tokenizer micro-optimization and add unit tests for long-token scenarios. Also will include canary harness tests for streaming with long sequences.
Rina (eng-sre): will implement circuit breaker and lower queue alerts.
Jules (support): will prepare customer impact summary and attach logs to PM-6610.
Nadia (oncall): thanks all. Leaving channel open for any new alerts.
